@configclass
class Terminations:
    """Termination configuration for butter above raisin box task."""
    time_out = DoneTerm(func=mdp.time_out, time_out=True)
    success = DoneTerm(
        func=object_on_top,
        params={"object": "butter", "reference_object": "raisin_box", "require_gripper_detached": True},
    )

@dataclass
class ButterAboveRaisinTask(Task):
    """Task: place the butter on top of the raisin box."""
    contact_object_list = ["butter", "raisin_box", "table"]
    scene = import_scene("butter_raisin_box.usda", contact_object_list)
    terminations = Terminations
    instruction = {
        "specific": "Place the butter on top of the raisin box. The butter should end up on the raisin box.",
        "vague": "Put butter on raisin box",
        "default": "Pick up the butter box and place it on top of the raisin box",
    }
    episode_length_s: int = 40
    attributes = ['spatial']
    subtasks = [
        pick_and_place(
            object=["butter"],
            container="raisin_box",
            logical="all",
            score=1.0
        )
    ]

const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+import json
+import math
+import traceback
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_robolab import Session
+
+
+OUT = "/app/output/trajectory.npz"
+s = Session("butter_above_raisin", instance="/app/instance.json")
+p = s.primitives()
+
+
+def log(label):
+    o = s.objects()
+    ep, eq = s.ee_pose()
+    print(label, json.dumps({
+        "status": s.status(),
+        "ee": np.round(ep, 4).tolist(),
+        "butter": o["butter"],
+        "raisin": o["raisin_box"],
+        "gripper": float(s.gripper_angle()),
+    }), flush=True)
+
+
+def move(label, pos, quat, **kw):
+    print("MOVE", label, np.round(pos, 4).tolist(), flush=True)
+    try:
+        p["move_ee"](pos, quat, **kw)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print("MOVE_ERROR", label, repr(e), flush=True)
+    log(label)
+
+
+def trial(grasp_z=0.018, offset_x=0.0, offset_y=0.0):
+    s.reset()
+    o = s.objects()
+    b = np.array(o["butter"]["bounds"])
+    r = np.array(o["raisin_box"]["bounds"])
+    target_xy = np.mean(b[:, :2], axis=0) + [offset_x, offset_y]
+    raisin_xy = np.mean(r[:, :2], axis=0)
+    # Butter's narrow horizontal dimension is y in this scene.
+    quat = p["top_down_quat"](0.0)
+    print("START", "butter_bounds", b.tolist(), "raisin_bounds", r.tolist(), "q", quat, "closing", p["get_finger_closing_dir"](), flush=True)
+    log("initial")
+    s.record_start()
+    p["open_gripper"](12)
+    move("above butter", [*target_xy, 0.14], quat, speed=0.3)
+    move("grasp height", [*target_xy, grasp_z], quat, speed=0.1)
+    p["close_gripper"](18)
+    log("closed")
+    move("lift", [*target_xy, 0.15], quat, speed=0.18)
+    move("above raisin", [*raisin_xy, 0.16], quat, speed=0.18)
+    # Start release when the butter should be just above the raisin top.
+    move("place", [*raisin_xy, 0.068], quat, speed=0.08)
+    p["open_gripper"](15)
+    log("released")
+    move("retract", [*raisin_xy, 0.14], quat, speed=0.15)
+    p["hold"](8)
+    log("final")
+    a = s.record_stop()
+    print("ACTION_SHAPE", a.shape, flush=True)
+    if s.status()["success"]:
+        s.save_trajectory(a, OUT)
+        print("SAVED", OUT, flush=True)
+    return s.status()
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        trial()
+    except Exception:
+        traceback.print_exc()
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
